subject: Temporary seat borrowing request & invoice offset for pilot
content:
Message 1/4
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@neurovista.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-24T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Pilot request — temporary seats & billing question

Hi Logan,

Quick one — we have a 3-week pilot starting Dec 1 where we need to scale up ~25 developer seats to run a limited integration test. Can we "borrow" 25 seats on top of our committed capacity? Two questions:

- How will the mid-cycle charge be calculated (proration or flat minimum)?
- If we return seats early, can Redwood issue an invoice credit on the following month rather than a retroactive refund? Our AP prefers credits against the next invoice.

Also, AP will need a single invoice they can pay (we're on Net30). Attach: SOW coming separately.

Thanks — Sam
Samantha Lee
Head of Integrations, NeuroVista
Samantha.lee@neurovista.ai
accounts-payable@neurovista.ai

---

Message 2/4
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@neurovista.ai>
Date: 2026-11-24T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot request — temporary seats & billing question

Jordan / Kimberly — looping you in to confirm the recommended billing path.

Summary of ask: NeuroVista needs +25 seats for 3 weeks starting 2026-12-01. They want a single invoice and prefer any returned-seat adjustment as a credit against the next invoice (Net30).

Options (high level):
1) Prorated add-on line item on Dec 1 invoice for the exact pro rata days. On seat return we issue a credit note referencing the original invoice; credit is applied to next invoice.
2) Create a short-term add-on with a refundable deposit/credit reserve and then issue a negative invoice (credit memo) mid-cycle when seats are removed.
3) Bill full month pro rata and then make an adjustment in the next billing cycle per NeuroVista's request (simpler for AP).

Recommendation: Option 1 (prorated add-on + credit memo on return) — matches their preference and preserves correct revenue recognition. We should produce a proforma for AP showing prorated seat count, unit price, proration calculation, and tax line (US customer, no VAT).

Kimberly — can you confirm we can issue a credit memo against the next invoice for returned seats and whether we need any special GL or AR notes for Net30?
Jordan — can you attach the short amendment (2–3 lines) to the contract reflecting temporary seat bulge and effective dates; deal ID NDV-92831. I'll attach a proposed pilot scope doc for context.

Attachments: pilot_scope.pdf (draft SOW)

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com

---

Message 3/4
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@neurovista.ai>
To: Logan Wright <samantha.lee@neurovista.ai>

Date: 2026-11-25T08:27:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot request — temporary seats & billing question

Thanks Logan — that approach sounds good. A few clarifications from AP:

- NeuroVista wants a single invoice dated 2026-12-01 with the prorated 25-seat line item + our standard subscription line.
- Net30 is fine.
- If you issue a credit memo for returned seats, please include the original invoice number and a short explanation we can attach to our records.
- We are US-based (no VAT).

I've attached the signed SOW for the pilot. We do not require a deposit.

Regards,
Sam

Attachments: signed_sow.pdf

Message 4/4
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>

Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, accounts-payable@neurovista.ai
Date: 2026-11-26T15:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot request — temporary seats & billing question

Hi Samantha — thanks for the signed SOW + clarity on AP. Confirming Redwood will proceed with Option 1 (prorated add-on + credit memo on return) and the specific operational steps below: 

1) Invoice: We will issue Invoice RDW-20261201-NDV for date 2026-12-01. It will contain:
   - Line A: Monthly subscription (as usual)
   - Line B: Temporary add-on — 25 developer seats (unit price $45 / seat) prorated to 21 days (2026-12-01 to 2026-12-21) = $X (detailed proration calc on invoice).
   - Tax: US — no VAT applied.
2) Payment terms: Net30 to accounts-payable@neurovista.ai
3) Credits: If seats are returned early, we will issue a credit memo referencing RDW-20261201-NDV. The credit will be applied to NeuroVista's next invoice. If NeuroVista prefers an immediate refund, we can escalate to finance but note refunds take 7–10 business days.
4) Documentation: credit memos will include the original invoice number and a short reason line ("returned seats — NDV pilot").

I've attached a draft invoice (invoice_draft_1201.pdf) with the proration math. If that looks good, we'll finalize and route to AP.

Links: HubSpot deal NDV-92831 (https://hubspot.redwood/DEAL-NDV-92831), SOW doc (https://app.redwood/doc/NDV-pilot-sow)

Kimberly Park
Billing Lead, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
